season.evidence: Logged North Face ascents fall in May, June and August only (6 total); web guides and trip reports describe continuous firm snow to the summit before mid-July, and a mid-August party still found snow base to top but heavy rockfall. Stored Jun-Jul window kept; August is a shoulder month.

facts.text: From roughly mid-May to mid-June the Chiwawa River Road is shut at a gate for mud season, which can add many miles of road walking or biking before the Phelps Creek trailhead; in early June expect blowdowns, deep creek fords on the Phelps Creek approach and firm snow a few miles up the trail.

By mid-August the glacier traverse toward the face crosses several wide-open crevasses, so rope up; a rappel station sits where the north ridge of Marmot Pyramid meets the ice, sparing a long descent onto the glacier.

In mid-August a party found continuous snow from the base to the summit apart from one rocky patch near halfway; steep snow took pickets, a few ice patches took screws, and the snow improved near the top.

notes: No harvested track follows the North Face, Entiat Ice Fall or Nothing Couloir as a complete round trip: every summited track is the south-side walk-up (Leroy Basin/South Shoulder/Freezer Pass) or a camp-based ascent. Nothing Couloir could not be found on any web page. Our Trailhead pin (48.0832,-120.835) agrees with the round-trip tracks' start (about 100-290 m).
